name: Vigilance
overview: The account in Joshua 2 highlights vigilance through the careful and secretive actions of the spies sent by Joshua to scout Jericho. Their mission required discretion, as the king of Jericho quickly became aware of their presence and sought to apprehend them. This narrative illustrates the necessity of watchfulness and prudence in carrying out God's commands, emphasizing the spiritual and practical importance of being alert to threats and challenges in the fulfillment of His purposes.
